verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The change replaces substring-based audit suppression with an exact App-identity, reviewed-SHA, and dedicated-comment-shape predicate. Unprovable or malformed receipts fail toward reposting the audit, preserving the trust-plane trail. The writer and reader share centralized construction, and the self-test performs a production-path round trip while separately pinning stale SHA, human/foreign identity, laundering, header suffix, extra/trailing blocks, bare markers, CRLF normalization, and empty bot identity. No trust check is weakened, and no diff-scoped correctness, security, or non-vacuity defect was found.
